title: Schedule a day of announcements
description: Implement schedule(items, budget). Each item is [title, priority, duration], with priority High, Medium or Low and positive duration. Process High then Medium then Low, FIFO within a priority. Schedule an item if it fits the remaining budget; otherwise defer it and keep scanning. Return [scheduled_titles, deferred_titles] in processing order. budget is non-negative.
hints: Maintain separate FIFO groups; write down what happens when an item does not fit.
